description: Aftershock Intelligence — models the secondary waves that follow a primary cascade event. Takes a primary shock (origin node, event type, magnitude, elapsed hours) and returns three aftershock waves: Wave 1 (0–72h immediate), Wave 2 (1–4wk policy response distortions), Wave 3 (1–6mo structural changes). Companion to market.cascade — run cascade first, then aftershock.

elapsedHours.description: Hours elapsed since the primary event. Default 24.

horizonHours.description: Forward horizon to model in hours. Default 4320 (6 months).

origin.description: Origin node ID from the primary cascade (e.g. "geo.conflict", "climate.drought").

name: intelligence.aftershock
